01

LEGO

I love LEGO for the possibilities in a handful of pieces. It’s a place to build, take something apart, and try a different idea simply because I’m curious where it might go.

02

Writing and ideas

Writing gives me another way to explore the things I care about. Engineering, moving between places, sports, and the people behind a project all leave me with questions worth thinking through.

03

Following curiosity

Not everything needs to become a finished project. I like making room for the ideas that begin as play — a different way to build something, a story to tell, or a question I want to follow.
